prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Adoption visual/style enhancements (compact grids, style selectors, pre-upload inspection, photo callouts), split-view path layouts, post-waiting auth reorders, path reassurance hints, generation tip carousels, desktop readiness hints, clear control copy, and compact welcome dashboards.
Hurt performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners, pre-adoption prep screens, pre- or post-certificate sign-in reorders, path speed callouts/headlines, instant activation incentives, and story scroll intros.
No clear effect seen: Audio and background notifications, account sync and persistence verification flows, waiting progress overlays, adoption incentive badges, desktop tray hints, and carousel or two-column path layouts.
Predictions were too low: Pre-upload style inspection, photo callouts, compact welcome dashboards, clear desktop control copy, path reassurance hints, and session safeguard hints.
Predictions were too high: Desktop finish redesigns, preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in stage shifts, instant activation highlights, and all tests yielding negative performance or no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Generation Status Sound & Visual Waiting Screen: Add a dedicated visual status screen with animated sound feedback and progress tracking while the desktop pet is being built. (why: The home waiting phase takes a mean of 2336 seconds; providing detailed background visual and audio status reduces perceived latency and drop-offs.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign-In Session Persistence Callout: Add an explicit safeguard hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in permanently links your pet to your account. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account persistence reassurance critical.)
2: [finish, hint] Desktop Tray Visibility Control Hint: Display a clear desktop tray hint on the welcome screen explaining how to bring the pet back if it is hidden. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on the desktop after onboarding completion.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Compact Layout Path Option Grid: Switch the choose path screen layout to compact mode with streamlined option badges. (why: Simplifying the layout helps decrease decision fatigue for users who linger on choose_path (mean 514s).)
4: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Name Reassurance Copy: Update adoption certificate copy to emphasize that pet names and attributes can be changed anytime in settings. (why: Users take a median of 89s and mean of 1017s on adoption screens, hesitating over permanent companion identity.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Background Processing Counter: Add a progress checklist and estimated completion time to the background pet processing waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336 seconds; showing checklist progress keeps users informed.)

scores.note: Waiting progress overlays and audio notifications showed no clear historical effect and require building a new screen.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in drop-off; session safeguard hints consistently outperform predictions.
Target step loses 28.1% of users, but desktop tray hints historically showed no clear effect.
High step duration and 14.8% drop; path layout tweaks average +1.7% lift across 5 prior tests.
Adoption has high pass rate (94.8%), but reassurance copy and identity reassurance hints regularly beat predictions.
Desktop readiness hints are helpful and home wait_info tests average a steady +1.1% lift over 11 trials.
